newsitem.title: USA: Delta flight aborts takeoff from Honolulu airport.
newsitem.headline: Delta flight aborts takeoff from Honolulu airport.

text.p: A dozen people were hurt while evacuating from a Delta Air Lines L-1011 jetliner that aborted its takeoff Thursday night from the Honolulu International Airport, air authorities said.

The injuries such as sprained ankles, scrapes and abrasions occurred when people aboard the plane slide down the evacuation shute and hit the asphalt runway, Hawaii state transportation spokeswoman Marilyn Kali said.
The injured were taken to a hospital.
It was not immediately clear what prompted the pilot to abort the takeoff of the Atlanta-bound plane at about 7:30 p.m. The Federal Aviation Administration is investigating the incident.
There were 309 people including crew aboard the plane.
